doctrines.note: Dual-titled thread "Flamers / Siphonarioi" — treated as one unit with a common nickname ("Flamers"), not a combined two-unit guide: no second unit's stats/doctrines are ever distinguished in the OP. Veterancy: Top Line. Hero pairing: not specified in this thread. Follow-up doctrine-ordering tip (2026-04-06, per OP, verbatim): "Unit DMG V > Unit DMG III > Unit DMG IV > ... rest is normal order — for some reason unit dmg 3 is better than unit dmg 4..." Playstyle: 2->1 combo maximizes damage but shouldn't be overused — only for (1) defending/attacking a chokepoint like a gate, or (2) when your 1 will hit the unit cap. Even at a gate chokepoint, 1->2 is better (longer CC uptime; noted as pre-Spartans-release advice). In open space, do NOT use 2->1 — too much space/bigger frontlines; instead 2 -> reposition -> 1 diagonal/straight (situational), or 2->1 diagonal, or 2 diagonal->1 straight. 2->1 doesn't add much extra damage: burn duration + CC resets by ticks from 1, only extra impact-DMG ticks are gained from 2. "Don't put" is a literal X placeholder in the OP — not fabricated. Edit timestamp (2026-05-27) pre-dates the 2026-06-25 Chaos patch anchor; Siphonarioi is NOT on the 13-unit Chaos shortlist, so staleAsOfPatch is not forced — noting pre-patch authorship per instructions only.

steps.text: 2 -> 1 combo maximizes damage, but only use in 2 situations: defending/attacking a chokepoint, or when your 1 will hit the unit cap. Even at a gate, 1 -> 2 is better for longer CC uptime (pre-Spartans-release note).

Do NOT use 2 -> 1 in open space — too much room to move, bigger frontlines. Instead: 2 -> reposition -> 1 diagonal/straight (situational, mixed vet can be better than full Top here), or 2 -> 1 diagonal, or 2 diagonal -> 1 straight.
2 -> 1 doesn't add much extra damage: burn duration + CC gets reset by ticks from 1 — the only gain from 2 is extra impact-damage ticks.
